evidenceKind: primary repository documentation and current issue/release page review; no peer runtime
question: Do newly surfaced DWG/DXF projects qualify as open-source, independent, route-matched evidence for the existing parity plan?

sources.revision: Mutable GitHub repository README and license disclosure reviewed 2026-10-21
sources.observed: The README says the source is currently proprietary despite being visible, pre-1.0, and targeted at ASCII/Binary DXF AC1009-AC1032. It explicitly says DWG, complete typed semantics/CRUD for all entities, rendering, and a B-rep kernel are not implemented. Its completion level and test claims are project statements, not independently reproduced.
sources.planDisposition: Exclude from the open-source peer census, comparator runs, and dependency options unless the license changes. No DWG or 3D claim follows from the declared DXF range.

sources.observed: The project separates its open-source viewer/data model from a licensed proprietary parser. Its default open-source DWG route uses LibreDWG. The proprietary parser disclosure claims 3DSOLID extraction and partial SAB decoding, but says full B-rep tessellation is unavailable and output is best-effort wireframe or bounding-box fallback.
sources.planDisposition: Count the default DWG route under LibreDWG lineage and exclude the licensed parser from open-source counts. If an authorized exact artifact is later used, restrict evidence to its actually exercised structural/carrier route; wireframe/bounds do not qualify analytic geometry or topology.

sources.revision: Mutable current README and route description reviewed 2026-10-21
sources.observed: The README states DWG is parsed through LibreDWG FFI, ASCII/Binary DXF uses the separate undxf crate, output is JSON/SVG/PNG, and writer APIs are not offered.
sources.planDisposition: Deduplicate DWG evidence with LibreDWG and exclude UnCAD from writer comparisons. Consider undxf only as a separately pinned DXF syntax/value observer for a named unresolved question.

sources.revision: Latest release page and mutable issue index reviewed 2026-10-21; current plan already binds v2026.42 source/lock lineage
sources.observed: The latest listed release is v2026.42 dated 2026-10-18 and uses an ACadRust-derived codec lineage as documented by the existing plan audit. Issue #1896, opened 2026-10-19, reports one AC1027 ACIS-solid drawing rejected at handle 0x5B87/type_code 37. The input is not available in this review and the issue postdates the pinned release.
sources.planDisposition: Keep as a codec-lineage-specific failure-shape lead under existing AC1027 modeler/ACIS owners. It is not a libdxfrw defect, an independent parser vote, or a current-release reproduction. Require a provenance-bound valid sample or a precise local/generated reproduction before revisiting.

sources.observed: The project describes itself as pre-alpha; it distinguishes a DWG container/object walker from incomplete per-entity decoding, has no DXF parser, documents no R14/R2007 DWG writer or automated native CAD acceptance, and publishes small, changing corpus denominators.
sources.planDisposition: Retain the existing optional structural/container role only. Bind source, build, inputs, and per-version denominator for any run; do not compare aggregates or use it for semantic, writer, or ACIS claims.

rules: Screen license, actual parser route, codec/kernel lineage, exact operation/version, and drop behavior before granting a project comparator weight.
Treat wrapper and application routes as consumers or projections unless source provenance establishes a distinct codec implementation.
Keep parser/carrier preservation, geometry semantics, and native consumer acceptance in separate evidence columns.
If a candidate cannot be bound cheaply, record NOT_RUN/UNBOUND and continue local source-backed work.
Do not add external/customer DWG/DXF fixtures; use existing admitted repository samples or scratch-generated controls.

limitations: GitHub README, issue, and release pages are mutable. This is source/documentation research only: no peer binary/package, proprietary parser, drawing, FreeCAD, or geometry kernel was run. Issue #1896 is not independently reproduced. No support claim is implied.
